# cpanel_spam_preference (Data Source)

Reads one documented cPanel SpamAssassin user preference. The data source never exposes arbitrary custom SpamAssassin configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_spam_preference" "required_score" {
  preference = "required_score"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `preference` (String) The supported SpamAssassin preference name: `required_score`, `score`, `whitelist_from`, or `blacklist_from`.

### Read-Only

- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the preference is explicitly configured for the account.
- `values` (Set of String) The preference values represented as an unordered set. This set is empty when the preference is not configured.
